preconditions.description: N must be a positive integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == N for s in stdout)
postconditions.description: All output strings must have a length equal to N.

postconditions.expression: all(s.count('1') >= s.count('0') for s in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output string must have at least as many 1's as 0's.
The output strings must be in decreasing order.
